Paper_Metadata.Paper_Title: Exploring microstructure evolution in CoCrFeNi high-entropy alloy during laser powder bed fusion: A molecular dynamics simulation

Process_Text.original: Large-scale molecular dynamics (MD) simulation using EAM potential. Laser power ranges from 200W to 400W, and scanning speed ranges from 400mm/s to 800mm/s.
Process_Text.simplified: 采用EAM势的大规模分子动力学模拟。激光功率200-400W，扫描速度400-800mm/s。

Microstructure_Text.original: The molten pool presents an elliptical shape. Rapid solidification leads to FCC as the dominant phase with perfect and partial dislocations.
Microstructure_Text.simplified: 熔池呈椭圆形。快速凝固导致FCC为主相，包含全位错和不全位错。

Microstructure_Info.Note: Perfect dislocations primarily at GBs; partial dislocations within grains.

Properties_Info.Test_Condition: At the center of laser spot, P=400W, v=400mm/s
Properties_Info.Note: Reaches the boiling point of the alloy.
Measured in the MD simulation cell.
